meta.title: iOS parity catch-up — 2026-07
meta.purpose: Machine-readable work-list of NEW functional changes the web app (mlr-app) shipped after the native app's last sync, to be hand-ported into the native SwiftUI app (mlr-app-ios). One backend, two clients: every RPC/table below is ALREADY LIVE on the shared Supabase project, so this is Swift-side service wiring + new SwiftUI surfaces only. No iOS SQL, no new migrations.
meta.ios_last_sync: 2026-07-18 — committee taxonomy Phases 1-4 (web #310/#311) + emoji/username (#315). iOS PARITY_PLAN workstreams A-F all verified LANDED (design foundation, Fest redesign, cabins parity, broadcasts+reminders, OnThisDay/post-reactions, committee self-service/AdminMembers/PreviewAs).
meta.delta_scope: web PRs #316-#362; backend migrations 0114-0128 (15 new since the 0108/0113 the last iOS plan referenced)

conventions.services: each web lib/*.ts seam maps to a Swift Services/*Service.swift; new RPCs use the Encodable param-struct + .rpc()/.from() idiom (see CabinService.swift, NotificationsService.swift)
conventions.param_names: RPC param names must match the SQL EXACTLY (p_scope, p_meeting, p_room_ids, p_approver_user_id, p_exclude_not_attending, ...). The web lib/*.ts files are the signature reference.
conventions.sheets: new sheets build on MLRSheet + fieldStyle; both light + dark palettes (Color(light:dark:) per Colors.swift)
conventions.mini_side_effects: emails and phone push are mac-mini side-effects (alert-mailer.js / push-sender.js / apns-sender.js) fired off Supabase realtime — the native app does NOT send them, but must surface the same opt-in checkboxes and honor the same notif/push pref rows so the mini fans them out.

do_not_rebuild.note: Tap a member's name in Admin -> Members to open profile — ALREADY on iOS (AdminMembersView row Button -> MemberSheetView).

Event-targeted email/push honor 'not going' — iOS CLIENT already collects the event target (EventTargetPicker wired into both admin composers) and passes p_event_id + p_exclude_not_attending. The 'honoring' on email/push is mac-mini side. iOS change = NONE, except note alert_recipients() dropped its old 1-arg overload (call the widened signature).

request_cabin_stay overload dedupe — backend plumbing only. iOS already calls this RPC; just use the canonical 8-arg signature request_cabin_stay(p_cabin,p_check_in,p_check_out,p_guests,p_notes,p_for_user,p_room_ids,p_notify).
Admin alerts back-link + collapsed composers — superseded by #341; port the #341 end-state (WS4), not this intermediate.
Intermediate steps of the Dinners redesign — port only the #318 end-state (WS6).

skip_web_only.reason: GitHub-Pages/Vercel build plumbing (#319/#320), desktop Lodge-Sidebar layout (#329/#330 — web-only, and reverted), PWA chunk-load recovery (#331), an   copy fix (#337), and mobile chat-open flicker / hydration-caching fixes (#354/#355/#357/#358/#360). None apply to a native SwiftUI app.

partial_skip.note: The Local Places two-tap-to-open fix is a web-only Safari <details> quirk — a native DisclosureGroup already opens on first tap. Only the 'Alerts' Home quick-link half of #351 is portable (WS7).

workstreams.title: Meeting scheduler (committee / house / family -> Google Meet or a real Event)
workstreams.size: largest new feature — entirely missing on iOS
workstreams.summary: A Doodle/when2meet-style scheduler pinned to any committee/area or house chat room, plus a family-wide scope. Organizer proposes candidate slots; members mark Yes/If-need-be/No per slot; organizer picks the winner and either pastes a Google Meet link (posts a join message + notifies the room) or creates a real calendar Event from it.

tables: meetings (scope_type committee|house|family, committee_id/committee_slug/area OR house_id, title, description, status open|scheduled|cancelled, chosen_slot_id, meet_url, respond_by, notify_email, proposal_email_sent_at, confirm_email_sent_at, created_event_id, source_meeting back-link)
meeting_slots (meeting_id, starts_at, ends_at [nullable = date range], duration_min, position)
rpcs: create_meeting(p_scope,p_committee_id,p_area,p_house_id,p_title,p_description,p_slots,p_respond_by,p_email)
create_scheduled_meeting(p_scope,p_committee_id,p_area,p_house_id,p_title,p_description,p_starts_at,p_ends_at,p_duration_min,p_meet_url)
set_my_availability(p_meeting,p_answers)  // bulk upsert {slotId:status}
finalize_meeting(p_meeting,p_slot,p_meet_url)  // organizer-or-admin; marks scheduled, posts room msg, fans meeting_scheduled
finalize_meeting_as_event(p_meeting,p_slot,p_kind,p_title,p_description,p_location)  // winning slot -> events row; carries Yes/If-need-be voters as UNCONFIRMED going/maybe
cancel_meeting(p_meeting)
delete_meeting(p_meeting)
can_organize_meeting(p_scope,p_committee_id,p_area,p_house_id)  // gate; UI must ask this too
set_event_attendance(p_event,p_status,p_days)  // now stamps confirmed=true on any self-write (reconfirm = re-tap Going/Maybe/Can't)
meeting_proposal_email(p_meeting) / meeting_confirmed_email(p_meeting)  // service_role, mac-mini only — NOT called by clients

workstreams.gating: can_organize_meeting = app admin (any room) OR a committee/area Lead (committee_roster role ending ' · Lead'). Houses = admin-only (no Lead). Family scope = admin-only. All 3 tables are members-only reads scoped to the room via can_access_committee_area (0063) / is_house_member (0064); family reads open to any signed-in member.
workstreams.google_meet: Guided in-app, ONE paste, NO OAuth. Finalize opens a step panel: 'Create Google Meet' button opens a prefilled Google Calendar event (googleCalendarCreateUrl); organizer adds the Meet link + saves, then pastes it back into a field. A linkless finalize is allowed (lock the time now, add link later via the response bar's 'Add the Meet link').
workstreams.modes: MeetingComposer toggle: 'Find a time' (propose slots -> vote, default) vs 'Set a time now' (one known time, no voting -> create_scheduled_meeting, immediately finalized). Plus a 'Times' vs 'Dates' toggle (defaults Dates for family scope) that swaps each slot's time picker for a date-range picker (meeting_slots.ends_at).
workstreams.family_scope_and_events: #328: scope='family' poll open to every member, organized admin-only, entered via Events tab '📅 Propose dates'; active poll shows as a card near the top of Events. Second finalize outcome 'Create an event' (any scope) writes an events row (source='meeting'); voters carry over as UNCONFIRMED RSVPs (event_attendance.confirmed=false), EventSheet shows '(hasn't confirmed)' to planners, and an auto-queued 14-day 'still coming?' reminder rides scheduled_broadcasts with payload.onlyUnconfirmed.
workstreams.area_targeting: #327: on a committee page, organizer can target a single role/area sub-channel (NULL area = committee-wide General). Reuses meetings.area + can_organize_meeting's area-Lead check — no migration.
workstreams.notifications: Two notif kinds meeting_proposed / meeting_scheduled -> every room member. Default ON in NotifPrefs (a 'Meetings' section, not admin-gated). Both in PUSHABLE_FEED_TYPES + a PushToggle row (off by default, opt-in).
workstreams.emails_mini: #324: optional PROPOSAL email (composer 'Also email everyone a link to vote' checkbox, default OFF -> p_email -> meetings.notify_email); automatic CONFIRMATION email on finalize WITH a Meet link (includes organizer). Both are mac-mini alert-mailer side-effects — iOS just surfaces the checkbox + knows confirmation always fires on link-present finalize.
surfaces: Create lives in the room's ⋯ menu (ChatMembersSheet) as '📅 Schedule a meeting', organizer-gated -> MeetingComposer. Houses previously had no ⋯ header button on iOS — add one for parity.

MeetingSection = the active-meeting response bar ONLY, pinned atop the chat body (renders nothing unless a meeting is live). Owns fetch + realtime + ?meeting=<id> deep-link; hosts MeetingSchedulerSheet (availability + tallies + who's-free + guided finalize).
EventsView embeds a family-scope MeetingSection + a '📅 Propose dates' entry (admin, family scope).

edit: Houses/HouseChatView.swift (⋯ menu + section; add ⋯ header button)
Events/EventComposer.swift + EventsService.swift (source='meeting', confirmed RSVP, onlyUnconfirmed reminder)
Shared/Components/ReminderScheduler.swift ('Only remind people who haven't confirmed yet' toggle)

workstreams.acceptance: Lead/admin proposes slots from a committee ⋯ menu; members vote; organizer finalizes with a pasted Meet link -> a join-link message lands in the room + everyone gets a meeting_scheduled notification. 'Set a time now' lands scheduled with no voting. From Events, an admin proposes dates family-wide, finalizes into a real Event, and Yes voters appear as unconfirmed RSVPs that flip confirmed on re-tap.

workstreams.title: Places to stay: open roster + per-place approver + guest messaging
workstreams.gap: iOS can EDIT existing cabins + rooms (AdminCabinDetails, CabinService.saveCabin/saveCabinRoom) but has NO 'Add a place' button, NO per-place approver, and NO guest messaging.
workstreams.summary: Places to stay grows from the fixed two cabins into an open-ended admin-managed roster. Admins add a place (kind cabin|house, bedrooms/beds, notes, and a per-place approver who need NOT be an app admin). The approver or an admin can message everyone currently/soon staying there.

tables: cabins.kind (text 'cabin'|'house' default 'cabin' — display badge only, no capacity behavior)
cabins.approver_user_id (uuid FK profiles, null = all admins)
cabin_messages (cabin_id, sender_id, subject, body, notify_email, email_sent_at, created_at)
rpcs: create_cabin(p_name,p_kind,p_room_count,p_bed_count,p_notes,p_approver_user_id)  // admin-only, auto-slugs
is_cabin_approver(p_cabin_id)  // admin OR that place's approver_user_id — the widened gate
send_cabin_message(p_cabin,p_subject,p_body,p_email)  // is_cabin_approver-gated; fans 'cabin_message' notif; returns recipient count
cabin_message_recipients(p_message)  // service_role, mac-mini only
review_cabin_stay / cancel_cabin_stay / admin_update_cabin_booking / set_booking_rooms  // all now gated on is_cabin_approver instead of admin-only

workstreams.notes: is_cabin_approver(cabin) widens BOTH the write gate on review/cancel/admin_update/set_booking_rooms AND the read RLS on cabin_bookings / cabin_booking_rooms — so a non-admin approver sees & acts on requests for their place(s) only. Recipients of send_cabin_message = distinct members with an approved booking whose stay hasn't ended (check_out >= today). 'cabin_message' is a PushType (DEFAULT_PUSH_TYPES); optional email BCCs approved-not-yet-ended guests with email_alerts on (mac-mini). notif_on_cabin_request also notifies the approver.

edit: Services/CabinService.swift (add createCabin, isCabinApprover, fetchMyApproverCabinIds, sendCabinMessage, fetchManageableCabins; add kind + approver_user_id to Cabin model)
Cabins/AdminCabinDetails.swift ('＋ Add a place' button -> create_cabin; ApproverPicker sheet -> approver_user_id; 'extra beds' relabel once named rooms exist)
Tabs/ProfileTab/Admin/AdminCabinBookings.swift ('📣 Message guests' button; compute canManage = admin OR approver-of->=1-place, not isAdmin)
add a self-hiding 'Requests to approve' surface for non-admin approvers (iOS equivalent of request-stay mounting AdminCabinBookings for non-admins)

workstreams.acceptance: An admin adds a new 'house' place with 3 bedrooms and sets a non-admin member as its approver; that member (no admin access) sees a 'Requests to approve' section, approves a stay, and taps 'Message guests' to notify everyone booked there.

workstreams.title: Family roster + widened email pools + email-from-chat
workstreams.gap: iOS has committee-scoped email (CommitteeEmailComposer everyone/byRole/pick) but NO family roster, NO house/App-Admins email pools, and NO 'Email members' entry in the chat ⋯ menu.
workstreams.summary: A master 'Family roster' of people NOT on the app yet (name + email + phone + optional house), managed by admins under Admin -> Members. Email is the join key: when someone verifies with a matching email their roster slot auto-links to the new account. Enables emailing an entire house (incl. not-yet-signed-up people) and adds House / App-Admins / by-Role pools to the People email composer, plus an 'Email members' button in every chat ⋯ menu.

tables: family_roster (name, email [unique lower-case], phone, house_id, position, linked_user_id, updated_at/by)
rpcs: house_member_recipients(hid)  // unions account members + account-less roster people assigned to the house
directory_recipients()
admin_recipients()  // App Admins pool (open to any signed-in member)
all_member_recipients()  // widened to include account-less roster
committee_member_recipients(cid)  // now ALSO returns roles text[] so the By-Role picker lights up
link_family_roster() / family_from_committee_roster() / sync_committee_roster_from_family()  // triggers — keep the two account-less rosters + accounts in sync by email (backend only)

workstreams.notes: Reads = signed-in members (carries PII/emails); writes = admins only. One person one record: adding an email'd account-less person to any committee roster also auto-adds them to the family roster, and editing name/email/phone on the family roster cascades back to their committee slots (triggers 0125). Roster 'name' seeds a new account's display_name on signup only if they didn't set their own. Emailing is a mailto:/native-mail hand-off — nothing sent from the app. #338: chat ⋯ 'Email members' is open to ANYONE in the room (no organizer gate), pre-scoped: committee General = whole roster, area sub-channel = that area's members, house channel = the house.

new: People/EmailMembersView.swift (generalize CommitteeEmailComposer: add House / App Admins / By-Role pools)
edit: Committees/CommitteeChatView.swift + Houses/HouseChatView.swift (add '✉️ Email members' to the ⋯ menu, pre-scoped)

workstreams.acceptance: Admin adds a family member (not on the app) to the roster with an email + house; a house email now includes them; when they later sign in with that email their account auto-links. From the People composer an admin narrows Family Fest to just 'Meals'. From a house chat ⋯ menu any member taps 'Email members' and the mail composer is pre-filled with the house.

workstreams.title: Unified broadcast composer + email-without-banner
workstreams.gap: iOS has TWO composers (AdminAlertComposer banner + AdminNotificationComposer push) each with a mirror-to-the-other toggle. Web merged them into ONE composer with 3 independent channels and added email-without-banner (announcements.show_banner) + callout side-actions. AdminScheduledBroadcasts shows sent history as a plain always-visible section, not a collapsed disclosure.
workstreams.summary: Replace the two admin forms with one AdminBroadcastComposer offering 3 independent channel checkboxes: 📣 Banner, 🔔 Activity tab, ✉️ Email (>=1 required). New: a send can email opted-in members WITHOUT painting a banner (announcements.show_banner=false). Wire the same two primitives into a Home callout's optional 'Also send a notification' / 'Also email everyone'. Tuck already-sent scheduled broadcasts into a collapsed disclosure.

tables: announcements.show_banner (bool default true — banner only renders rows where true; mini push-sender skips the phone push when false, since push rides with the banner not email-alone)
rpcs: run_scheduled_broadcasts()  // +show_banner support (server-side, no iOS change)
postAnnouncement() / sendActivityNotification()  // web primitives in lib/broadcast.ts — mirror as service helpers

workstreams.notes: Banner + Email both write ONE announcements row; Activity tab uses send_broadcast_notification. Scheduling queues one scheduled_broadcasts row per channel-group ('announcement' for banner/email, 'notification' for activity) at the same send time. Callout side-actions (in AdminCalloutsView) default OFF each open — not a saved property — and fire right after saveCallout using the callout's own eventTarget.

edit: Tabs/ProfileTab/Admin/AdminAlertComposer.swift + AdminNotificationComposer.swift (retire in favor of the merged composer)
Tabs/ProfileTab/Admin/AdminScheduledBroadcasts.swift (tuck 'Recent'/sent into a collapsed DisclosureGroup below pending)

workstreams.acceptance: One admin form sends a banner + Activity entry + email in a single action; unchecking Banner emails opted-in members with no banner painted and no phone push. The Scheduled queue shows only pending items with sent history collapsed behind a 'Previously sent' disclosure.

workstreams.title: Chat parity: optimistic send, typing indicators, smart scroll, moderation, direct tunnel
workstreams.gap: iOS chat already has reactions/who-reacted, mentions, 24h edit + soft-delete. MISSING: optimistic send (waits for server round-trip), typing indicators, smart auto-scroll + jump-to-bottom pill (current auto-scroll always fires, no pill), chat message moderation (chat messages can't be reported and never enter the queue; no status filter), and a direct Home->House-chat tunnel (currently two hops).
workstreams.extra_commit: 4b0dce7 (Wave 4 smart auto-scroll + scroll-to-bottom pill — a direct-to-main commit, NOT a numbered PR)

items.build: Insert a temp bubble (id `temp-<ts>`) with any attached media the instant send is tapped; clear the composer; upload media + insert; refetch and drop the temp bubble. On failure restore the FULL draft (text, pending media, mentions, reply-to). Moderation stays async (see below).
items.ios_evidence: HouseChatView.send()/CommitteeChatView.send() currently await the insert then append the returned row — no pending bubble.

items.build: A live 'X is typing…' row above the composer, one/two names or 'Several people are typing', animated dots, nothing when idle. Rides its OWN Supabase Realtime broadcast channel `typing:<roomKey>` (SEPARATE from the message subscription so it can't disrupt delivery). notifyTyping() throttled per keystroke (only when text non-empty, self:false); each typer self-clears ~4.5s after last keystroke. roomKey = `committee:<slug>:<area>` or `house:<slug>`. Ephemeral — nothing persisted, no table/RPC.
items.ios_evidence: No typing state/channel anywhere on iOS.

items.build: Jump-to-bottom on first open; smooth-follow only when ALREADY at bottom; a tappable '↓ New messages' pill when scrolled up (auto-hides at bottom); your own optimistic sends always pin to bottom.
items.ios_evidence: Both chats do .onChange(messages.count){scrollTo(last)} — always scrolls, no scroll-position detection, no pill.

items.build: Add committee_messages.status / house_messages.status (visible|pending|hidden). RLS returns non-'visible' rows only to author + admins, so a held message must silently DISAPPEAR from the room on refetch (retroactive hold via the media_moderation verdict trigger, arriving seconds after the optimistic post). Add a 'Report' action to the chat bubble context menu (report_content) and include held chat messages in the admin review queue (moderation_queue) + Approve/Remove (set_content_status +committee_message/house_message entity types). Chat text also rides the deterministic blocklist floor server-side. AI media grading + backfill run on the mac-mini — NOT native.
items.ios_evidence: AdminModerationView handles post/post_comment only; chat bubble menus have React/Edit/Delete but NO Report; chat has no status field/filter.

items.build: Give the Home House-Hub card a dedicated 'Chat' button that deep-links STRAIGHT into the house chat room (no stop at the hub). Keep the card body -> House Hub.
items.ios_evidence: iOS path is Home -> HouseHubView -> 'House chat' link (two hops).

rpcs: set_content_status(p_entity_type,p_entity_id,p_status)  // +committee_message/house_message
moderation_queue()  // +held chat messages
report_content(...)  // now usable from chat

Models/Post.swift or chat message models (add status)
Tabs/HomeTab/HomeView.swift + House Hub card (direct chat button)

workstreams.acceptance: Sending a chat message shows the bubble instantly; a second device shows 'X is typing…' as they type; scrolling up reveals a 'New messages' pill; reporting a message removes it for everyone but the author/admins and surfaces it in the review queue; the Home house card jumps straight into the room.

sequencing.rationale: WS1 (meetings) is the biggest net-new surface and touches chat + committees + events. WS5 (chat) is high-visibility daily-use parity. WS2/WS3 are admin/ops features. WS4/WS6/WS7 are self-contained. WS8 is polish last. All backend is already live on the shared Supabase project — no migration ordering to worry about; port in any order the team prefers.
sequencing.branch: one branch per workstream on btheis15/mlr-app-ios; draft PR after the first substantive push; update the iOS repo's own docs (IOS_PARITY_PLAN.md / IOS_COMPAT.md) as features land.
sequencing.build_check: open 'MLR App.xcodeproj', resolve SPM, Build (⌘B). Watch for new Swift files missing target membership. Verify light AND dark on every new surface.
